title: Italian-Style Stir-Fried Pork Chops
description: A fusion of Italian flavors with a Peruvian twist, this stir-fry is a unique and delicious meal option.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the pork chops and cook until browned, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Remove the pork chops from the skillet and set aside.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the bitter greens and crisp bell peppers to the skillet and cook until the vegetables are tender-crisp, about 2-3 minutes.
Add the cooked pork chops back into the skillet and stir in the peruvian aji amarillo pepper flakes, if using.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve the stir-fry hot, garnished with additional bitter greens if desired.
